title: Density Feedback Control for Transferability of Generative Sparse Adversarial Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2611.25001v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generator-based sparse adversarial attacks train encoder--decoder networks to produce transferable sparse perturbations for black-box robustness evaluation. Their perturbation density, however, is set only indirectly by a fixed sparsity coefficient whose mapping to density is unknown and shifts during training, so reaching a target density requires re-tuning; this fixed pressure also yields little transferability gain once density reduction begins. We propose Density Feedback Control (DFC), which tightens or relaxes this coefficient at the end of each epoch according to the gap between the observed hard-mask density and the target, without changing the generator architecture or loss. At a 10\% target density, DFC brings the mean density of three base attacks within one percentage point of the target in a single run and improves the transfer attack success rate (ASR) of two of them on CNN and Transformer targets, including under per-image

translated_title: 面向生成式稀疏对抗攻击可迁移性的密度反馈控制
translated_abstract: 基于生成器的稀疏对抗攻击通过训练编码器-解码器网络来生成可迁移的稀疏扰动，用于黑盒鲁棒性评估。然而，其扰动密度只能通过一个固定的稀疏系数间接设定，该系数到密度的映射关系未知且在训练过程中会发生漂移，因此要达到目标密度需要反复重新调参；而且这种固定的压力一旦密度开始下降，几乎不再带来可迁移性方面的收益。我们提出密度反馈控制（DFC）方法，在每个训练轮次（epoch）结束时，根据观测到的硬掩码密度与目标密度之间的差距来收紧或放宽该稀疏系数，而无需改变生成器的架构或损失函数。在10%的目标密度下，DFC使三种基础攻击的平均密度在单次运行中与目标的偏差控制在一个百分点以内，并提升了其中两种攻击在CNN和Transformer目标模型上的迁移攻击成功率（ASR），包括在逐图像（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出密度反馈控制（DFC）方法，通过在每个训练轮次根据观测密度与目标密度的差距动态调整稀疏系数，使生成式稀疏对抗攻击无需重新调参即可在单次运行中精确达到目标扰动密度，并提升迁移攻击成功率。
